---
title: "R code to generate Butterfly Plot"
output: html_document
params:
    ordinal_data: NA
    no_doseH: NA
    toxicH: NA
    times_H: NA
    ordinal_date: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    location: 0.7
    subtitle: "Symptomatic Adverse Event"
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run them once
# install.packages("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer")
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Define parameters
ordinal_data <- params$ordinal_data
no_doseH <- params$no_doseH
toxicH <- params$toxicH
tps <- params$times_H
ordinal_date <- params$ordinal_date

# Create list of timepoints within the specified range
list_T <- unique(ordinal_data %>% filter(timepoint <= tps[2] & timepoint >= tps[1]) %>% select(timepoint))

# Find the minimum and maximum timepoints for the specified range
tps[1] <- min(list_T$timepoint)
tp_first <- as.symbol(paste0("tp_", tps[1]))

tps[2] <- max(list_T$timepoint)
tp_last <- as.symbol(paste0("tp_", tps[2]))

# Filter data to get relevant doses and PRO domains within the specified timepoints then calculate the change in grade between the two timepoints
ordinal_dataH <- ordinal_data %>%
  filter(dose %in% no_doseH) %>%
  filter(toxicity %in% toxicH) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(has_tp = any(timepoint == tps[2])) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c(tps[1], tps[2])) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = grade, names_prefix = "tp_") %>%
  mutate(grade_change = case_when(
    has_tp == FALSE ~ "ICE",
    TRUE ~ as.character(!!tp_first - !!tp_last)
  ))

# If there are any missing grade changes, replace them with "Missing"
ordinal_dataH$grade_change[is.na(ordinal_dataH$grade_change) == TRUE] <- "Missing"

# Create list of dose levels as labels
levs <- rev(no_doseH)
dose_labelsH <- paste0("Dose ", levs)

# Create a data frame with the proportion of patients in each grade change category for each dose and PRO domain
propH <- ordinal_dataH
propH <- propH %>%
  group_by(toxicity, dose) %>%
  count(grade_change) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(original = TRUE) %>%
  complete(toxicity, dose, grade_change, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(toxicity, dose) %>%
  mutate(n.pat = sum(n[grade_change != "ICE"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / n.pat) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n)

# Convert variables to factors for plotting
propH$toxicity <- as.factor(propH$toxicity)
propH$dose <- as.factor(propH$dose)
propH$dose <- factor(propH$dose, levels = rev(levels(propH$dose)))
propH$grade_change <- as.character(propH$grade_change)

# Create labels for missing data to be displayed on the plot
missing_H <- propH %>%
  subset(grade_change == "Missing") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("Unreported: ", round(proportion, 2) * 100, "%"))

missing_H <- cbind(missing_H, rep(params$location, times = nrow(missing_H)))
colnames(missing_H)[8] <- "loc"
levels(missing_H$dose) <- dose_labelsH


# Create a new data frame where positive proportions represent improvement and negative proportions represent worsening
propHadj <- propH
propHadj <- propHadj %>% mutate(proportion = ifelse(grade_change >= 0, proportion, -proportion))
propHadj <- propHadj %>%
  subset(grade_change != "Missing") %>%
  subset(grade_change != 0)
propHadj <- propHadj %>% filter(original)

# Create data frame with positions for the % labels for each bar segment in the plot
valH <- propHadj
valH <- valH %>%
  group_by(dose, toxicity) %>%
  arrange(dose, toxicity, grade_change) %>%
  mutate(percent = paste0(round(abs(proportion) * 100, 1), "%")) %>%
  mutate(
    cumsum_pos = if_else(proportion > 0, cumsum(if_else(proportion > 0, proportion, 0)), NA_real_),
    cumsum_neg = if_else(proportion < 0, cumsum(if_else(proportion < 0, proportion, 0)), NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos = case_when(
      proportion > 0 ~ cumsum_pos - 0.5 * proportion,
      proportion < 0 ~ cumsum_neg - 0.5 * proportion,
      TRUE ~ 0 # fallback for proportion == 0
    )
  )

# Convert grade change to factor for plotting purposes (except missing values)
valH <- valH %>% subset(grade_change != "ICE")
valH$grade_change <- factor(valH$grade_change)
levels(valH$dose) <- dose_labelsH

# Create arrows for improvement and worsening directions on the plot
arrowdfH <- tibble(
  toxicity = factor(as.character(unique(toxicH)), levels = levels(valH$toxicity)),
  x = 0.5,
  xend = 0.5,
  y = 0,
  yend = 1
)

arrowdf.revH <- tibble(
  toxicity = factor(as.character(unique(toxicH)), levels = levels(valH$toxicity)),
  x = 0.5,
  xend = 0.5,
  y = 0,
  yend = -1
)

# Create a data frame with the number of patients on each dose to be used in the x-axis label of the plot
ice_n_patH <- propHadj %>% distinct(dose, n.pat)

# Create a data frame containing the colours and labels for each grade change category
labels <- cbind(
  c(-5, -4, -3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  c(
    "red", "deeppink", "orange", "gold", "lightyellow3", "lightblue",
    "darkseagreen3", "darkolivegreen3", "chartreuse3", "chartreuse4"
  ),
  rev(c(
    "Improve by 5", "Improve by 4", "Improve by 3", "Improve by 2", "Improve by 1", "Worsen by 1",
    "Worsen by 2", "Worsen by 3", "Worsen by 4", "Worsen by 5"
  ))
)

colnames(labels) <- c("score", "colour", "leg")

# Function to assist in subgraph labels
formatterH <- function(toxic = toxicH, subtitle = params$subtitle) {
  paste(subtitle, toxicH, sep = " ")
}

# Generate the butterfly plot
ggplot(valH %>% subset(toxicity %in% toxicH), aes(x = dose, y = proportion, fill = grade_change, group = dose)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs, breaks = c(0), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)
  ) +
  facet_grid(toxicity ~ ., scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(formatterH)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = labels[, 1],
    values = labels[, 2],
    labels = labels[, 3]
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(y = pos, label = percent), size = 3, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Dose (N=", paste(ice_n_patH$n.pat, collapse = "; "), ")"),
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Change in Severity "
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey", size = 1) +
  geom_segment(
    data = arrowdfH,
    aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
    colour = "darkgrey",
    size = 0.8,
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.1, "inches")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(1.5, 0))) +
  geom_segment(
    data = arrowdf.revH,
    aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
    colour = "darkgrey",
    size = 0.8,
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.1, "inches")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(x = -0.25, y = 0.5, label = "Improvement"), aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(x = -0.25, y = -0.5, label = "Worsening"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = missing_H %>% filter(toxicity %in% toxicH),
    aes(x = dose, y = loc, label = label, group = dose),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  ggtitle(params$title) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"))
```
